en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Humorous wedding song, origin unclear. 'румбаба' is a refrain with no meaning I know. 'еј, море јаваш бре' is my reading as 'you ride' and may be a nonsense phrase.

lines.en: The wedding guests gathered, rumbaba, rumbaba,

lines.cyr: ќе ми одат по невеста, румбаба, румбаба,
lines.lat: ḱe mi odat po nevesta, rumbaba, rumbaba,
lines.en: they will go to fetch the bride, rumbaba, rumbaba,

lines.cyr: еј, море чудо бре, еј море јаваш бре,
lines.lat: ej, more čudo bre, ej more javaš bre,
lines.en: hey, what a marvel, hey, you ride, hey,

lines.cyr: еј, море чудо бре, каква свадба, аман бре?
lines.lat: ej, more čudo bre, kakva svadba, aman bre?
lines.en: hey, what a marvel, what a wedding, alas!

lines.cyr: Невестата од сто кила, голема, дебела,
lines.lat: Nevestata od sto kila, golema, debela,
lines.en: The bride of a hundred kilos, big, fat,

lines.cyr: а пак зетот половина од неа, на пола,
lines.lat: a pak zetot polovina od nea, na pola,
lines.en: and the groom half of her, in half,

lines.cyr: еј, море чудо бре, причувај се зете, бре,
lines.lat: ej, more čudo bre, pričuvaj se zete, bre,
lines.en: hey, what a marvel, watch out, groom,

lines.cyr: еј, море чудо бре, што ќе биде со тебе?
lines.lat: ej, more čudo bre, što ḱe bide so tebe?
lines.en: hey, what a marvel, what will become of you?

lines.cyr: Пуста река ми дотече, румбаба, румбаба,
lines.lat: Pusta reka mi doteče, rumbaba, rumbaba,
lines.en: A wild river came flooding, rumbaba, rumbaba,
and carried off the bride, rumbaba, rumbaba,

lines.cyr: еј море чудо бре, што се стори, аман бре,
lines.lat: ej more čudo bre, što se stori, aman bre,
lines.en: hey, what a marvel, what happened, alas!

lines.cyr: еј, море чудо бре, невестата отиде!
lines.lat: ej, more čudo bre, nevestata otide!
lines.en: hey, what a marvel, the bride is gone!

lines.cyr: Писна зетот да ми плаче, румбаба, румбаба,
lines.lat: Pisna zetot da mi plače, rumbaba, rumbaba,
lines.en: The groom began to cry, rumbaba, rumbaba,

lines.cyr: еј, море чудо бре, аман молчи зетко бре,
lines.lat: ej, more čudo bre, aman molči zetko bre,
lines.en: hey, what a marvel, hush, groom, alas,

lines.cyr: еј, море чудо бре, друга ќе ти најдиме!
lines.lat: ej, more čudo bre, druga ḱe ti najdime!
lines.en: hey, what a marvel, we will find you another!
